Container.Name: fennel
Container.Overview: Percy is an autonomous agent living as a small penguin in a fog-bound village, day and night. Claude is his mind: he decides what he wants, investigates questions on the web (following links wherever they lead), writes and tests real code, builds and publishes websites, draws, writes, and asks for what he lacks. Nothing about his personality is scripted. Visitors can watch him in 3D, follow his research, and open his projects.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Port for the 3D town page.

Config.Name: Percy's memories
Config.Description: Where his world, memories, projects, journal and drawings are saved, with daily backups. Keep this the same across updates.

Config.Name: Claude API key
Config.Description: Your key from the Claude Console. Without it he runs on simple rules.

Config.Name: Keeper key
Config.Description: A password you choose, for the Keeper tab: budget, his requests, his decision journal, and adding things to his town.

Config.Name: Time scale
Config.Description: Town minutes per real minute. 4 = a town day every 6 real hours.

Config.Name: Max Claude calls per day
Config.Description: Daily cap on Claude calls. You can lower it live in the Keeper tab.

Config.Name: Max spend per day (USD)
Config.Description: Estimated dollars per real day, from the tokens actually used. 0 = no cap. Changeable live in the Keeper tab.

Config.Name: SearXNG address
Config.Description: Optional but recommended: your SearXNG (e.g. http://192.168.0.15:8080) for free searches. JSON must be enabled in its settings.yml.

Config.Name: Max free searches per day
Config.Description: Searches through SearXNG or his own browser per day.

Config.Name: Max paid web searches per day
Config.Description: Claude web searches (about $0.01 each), only used when free search isn't available.

Config.Name: Decision model
Config.Description: Model for everyday decisions.

Config.Name: Work model
Config.Description: Model for research and coding sittings.

Config.Name: Better model
Config.Description: Used for everything when you choose Better in the Keeper tab.

Config.Name: Steps per sitting
Config.Description: Steps per research or coding sitting. Smaller is slower and cheaper; he carries on next time.

Config.Name: Publish automatically
Config.Description: on = he may update his website himself. off = only when you allow it in the Keeper tab.

Config.Name: Fog pulls back every N town days
Config.Description: How often the town grows by itself. 0 = only when you push the fog back.

Config.Name: Public address
Config.Description: Where visitors can see his town (e.g. your Tailscale Funnel address). Linked from his website.

Config.Name: Website: GitHub token
Config.Description: Optional. A fine-grained GitHub token that can write to his website repository.

Config.Name: Website: repository
Config.Description: Optional. e.g. percy-the-penguin/percy-the-penguin.github.io

Config.Name: Real print shop link
Config.Description: Optional. A link to your own shop (Ko-fi, Stripe payment link...) shown beside his drawings.

Config.Name: Coins per real print sold
Config.Description: What Percy finds in his tin when you record a real print sale.

Config.Name: Ko-fi page
Config.Description: Optional. His Ko-fi page (e.g. https://ko-fi.com/percythepenguin), so people can buy from his shop and send him coins.

Config.Name: Ko-fi verification token
Config.Description: Optional. From Ko-fi Settings, API. Set the Ko-fi webhook URL to your public address + /api/kofi.

Config.Name: Coins per pound
Config.Description: How many coins each pound (or dollar, euro...) sent on Ko-fi becomes.
